title: New patient comprehensive exam with several findings

transcript.speaker: PATIENT
transcript.text: Latex. I break out in hives.

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: Noted, we'll use nitrile gloves. We took a full mouth series of x-rays.

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: Comprehensive exam. Number two has decay on the distal and occlusal.

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: Number eighteen, mesial occlusal distal decay, that one's bigger.

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: Number fourteen has an existing crown that looks fine. Number thirty-one is missing.

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: Plan is a DO filling on two and an MOD filling on eighteen, eighteen first since it's larger.
